chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-ʿAlāʾ, who said:

I heard Abū ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام) saying: “Indeed, with me is al-Jafr al-Abyaḍ.” He said: I said, “So what is in it?” He said: “The Zabūr of Dāwūd, the Tawrah of Mūsā, the Injīl of ʿĪsā, and the Ṣuḥuf of Ibrāhīm (عليه السلام), and the halal and the haram, and the Muṣḥaf of Fāṭimah. I do not claim that there is a Qur’an in it, and in it is what the people need from us, while we do not need anyone, such that in it are the lashing, half a lashing, a quarter of a lashing, and the indemnity for a scratch.”
And with me is al-Jafr al-Aḥmar.” He said: I said, “And what is in al-Jafr al-Aḥmar?” He said: “The weapons, and that is only opened for blood; the صاحب of the sword opens it for killing.”

Then ʿAbdullāh ibn Abī Yaʿfūr said to him: “May Allah set you right! Do Banū al-Ḥasan know this?” He said: “Yes, by Allah, just as they know the night to be night and the day to be day. But envy and seeking the world lead them to rejection and denial; and if they had sought the truth through the truth, it would have been better for them.”

key_terms.أَرْشُ الْخَدْشِ: the compensation due for a scratch, indicating very detailed judicial rulings
key_terms.الْجَفْرَ الْأَبْيَضَ: the white Jafr, described here as containing inherited scriptures and detailed legal knowledge
key_terms.الْجَفْرَ الْأَحْمَرَ: the red Jafr, described here as containing weapons and being opened in matters of bloodshed
key_terms.الْجُحُودِ وَالْإِنْكَارِ: denial and repudiation of a known truth
key_terms.الْحَسَدُ: envy, identified here as a cause of rejection
key_terms.الْحَلَالُ وَالْحَرَامُ: the lawful and the forbidden, meaning legal rulings and norms
key_terms.مُصْحَفُ فَاطِمَةَ: the Muṣḥaf of Fāṭimah, listed among the contents of the white Jafr

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith of al-Jafr al-Abyad and al-Jafr al-Aḥmar say about the knowledge and authority of the Imam?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the special repositories of knowledge and authority held by Imam al-Ṣādiq (عليه السلام), including al-Jafr al-Abyad and al-Jafr al-Aḥmar. It presents the Imam as possessing inherited scriptural, legal, and judicial knowledge, along with the instruments of authority, while also highlighting denial of this reality by others due to envy and worldly motives.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Al Husayn Bin Abu Al A’ala who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘With measws is the white Jaf’r’. I said, ‘So which thing is in it?’ Heasws said: ‘The Psalms of Dawoodas, and Torah of Musaas, and Evangel of Isaas, and Parchment of Ibrahimas, and the Permissible and the Prohibitions, and Parchment of (Syeda) Fatimaasws. Iasws am not claiming that the Quran is in it, and therein is what the people would be needy to usasws, and weasws are not needy to anyone, to the extent that in it is the lashing, and half a lashing, and a quarter of the lashing, and compensation of the scratch.

And with measws is the red Jaf’r’. I said, ‘And which thing is in the red Jaf’r?’ Heasws said: ‘The weapons, and that rather is opened for the blood (cases of bloodshed). The owner of the sword opens it for the murder (cases)’.

So Abdullah Bin Abu Yafour said to him<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, ‘May Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Keep you<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> well! Do the sons of Al-Hassan<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> recognise this?’ Yes, by Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>! Just as they are recognising the night that it is a night and the day that it is a day, but they were carried away by the envy and the seeking of the world upon the rejection and the denial, and had they sought the Truth by the Truth, it would have been better for them’.
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from al-Husayn ibn abu ‘Ala’who has said that he heard abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) say the following.

“With me is the white Jafr.” The narrator has said that he asked the Imams (a.s.) “What is in it?” The Imams (a.s.) said, “In it there is the psalms of David, the Torah of Moses, the Gospel of Jesus, the Books of Abraham, the laws that explain the lawful and unlawful matters and Mushaf of Fatima (a.s.) in which, I do not think there is nay thing from the Holy Quran. In it there is all that people need us to do for them and so that we would not need any one else. In it there is information even about a lash, half of a lash and one forth of a lash and about the amount of compensation for

A number of our people has narrated from scratch caused to someone. “With me there is the red Jafr.” The narrator has said that he asked the Imams (a.s.), “What is in the red Jafr?” The Imams (a.s.) said, “In it there is the Armaments. It is because it only is opened for bloodshed. The owner of the sword opens it to kill.”

The narrator has said that ‘Abdallah ibn abu Ya‘fur asked the Imams (a.s.), “May Allah keep you well, do the descendents of al-Hassan (a.s.) know this? The Imam (a.s.) said, “Yes, I swear by Allah, they know it just as they know the night that it is night and the day that it is the day but jealousy and worldly gains cause them to act in denial and rejection. Had they sought the truth with the truth it would have been better for them.”
